user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: EV Ledger tracks one vehicle's trips and charging costs. Add more vehicles later by repeating this from Settings → Devices & services.

vehicle_device.title: Choose your vehicle
vehicle_device.description: Pick the Tesla device this EV Ledger entry tracks. Its entities (battery, odometer, location, etc.) are found automatically — you'll only be asked to fill anything in by hand if something couldn't be auto-detected.

vehicle.title: Vehicle entities
vehicle.description: Some entities couldn't be auto-detected from the device — fill in the rest here (or correct anything that was guessed wrong).

data.outside_temp_entity: Outside temperature sensor (optional, enables efficiency-vs-temperature tracking)

chargers.title: Charging sources
chargers.description: Choose which chargers EV Ledger should pull cost/session data from.

zaptec_device.title: Choose your Zaptec charger
zaptec_device.description: Its power/energy entities are found automatically.

zaptec.title: Zaptec entities
zaptec.description: Some entities couldn't be auto-detected — fill in the rest here (or correct anything guessed wrong). Zaptec reports live power and session energy, but not cost.

monta_device.title: Choose your Monta charger
monta_device.description: Its cost entity — and your account's wallet balance, if found — are resolved automatically.

monta.title: Monta entities
monta.description: Some entities couldn't be auto-detected — fill in the rest here (or correct anything guessed wrong). Monta reports the cost of its most recent charge session.

efficiency.title: Efficiency comparison
efficiency.description: Pick your exact model/trim to compare real-world Wh/km against its official rated (WLTP) consumption, bucketed by outside temperature. These are best-effort published figures, not read from your car — pick 'Custom' if you know your own numbers, or 'Skip' to leave this off.

efficiency_custom.title: Custom efficiency numbers
efficiency_custom.description: Enter your vehicle's usable battery capacity and its official rated consumption. Check your delivery paperwork or Tesla account if you want the exact figure for your configuration.
